text:
Noah: Hi finance team — corporate card declined at a kiosk in Lisbon this morning, had to use my personal card for a taxi and lunch. Merchant on the receipt is just 'TAXI-764' and the card statement shows a payment to 'TRANSFERS PT'. Total €46.80 (taxi €32.00 + lunch €14.80). No VAT line on the paper receipt. Can I get reimbursed and what code should I use?

Priya: Sorry about the decline. Can you confirm the reason you were charged on personal card (vendor refused corpcard?) and whether this was client-facing? We need manager approval for customer-hosted meals.

Noah: Corpcard chip failed on their POS terminal; they said card type not accepted. Taxi was client pick-up to office, lunch was a working lunch with Acme. Client was present. I asked the driver for a receipt but it's handwritten and just shows amount and taxi number. Photo: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/noah_lisbon_0326.jpg Card txn (personal): https://files.redwood.example/bank/personal_tx_2041125678.png

Priya: Approve the reimbursement for both items as business expenses. For the meal, tag PROJ-58 and note "client working lunch". For taxi, tag GL 6102 travel. @Carmen can you confirm supporting docs needed since merchant name is ambiguous and no VAT?

Carmen: Thanks. For personal card reimbursements we need: (1) original receipt image, (2) cardholder statement showing the posted amount and merchant name, (3) explanation why corporate card couldn't be used, (4) manager approval. Since the merchant name is fuzzy, include photo plus the transaction line from your bank showing 'TRANSFERS PT' and the timestamp. VAT reclaim unlikely without proper invoice, so code meals to GL 6550 (Non-reclaimable meals) unless vendor provides VAT invoice later.

travel-bot: Reminder: If corpcard fails at POS, file a card decline report within 48h at https://travel.redwood.example/decline-report to help Procurement unblock vendor acceptance.

Noah: Uploaded bank txn and receipt to portal and filed decline report: https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2041125678. Attached message: "Corpcard declined by POS, used personal card; client present: Jordan Park (Acme)"

Carmen: Received. For the taxi please enter two lines in the expense portal: (A) Taxi €32.00 paid personal card -> GL 6102 -> reimbursable; (B) Meal €14.80 paid personal card -> GL 6550 -> tag PROJ-58 and mark non-reclaimable VAT. Add manager approval screenshot.

Noah: Submitted as instructed and added Priya approval screenshot and the bank screenshot. One question: do I include the tip? I left €3.00 cash tip.

Priya: Tips under €10 are reimbursable as travel incidental. Include as separate petty cash line and mark as reimbursable.

Carmen: Good. We will process reimbursement in next payroll cycle (or via standalone refund if urgent). Note: finance will review the decline report and if card hardware / vendor issue is confirmed Procurement will work with POS vendor to accept corpcard types.

finance-bot: Thread checklist complete: manager approval attached -> receipts + bank txn attached -> decline report filed -> coding: Taxi GL 6102 reimbursable; Meal GL 6550 client-tagged PROJ-58 non-reclaimable -> tip petty cash €3.00 reimbursable. Payment method: reimbursement to personal card via payroll adjustment / expense run. Thread closed by finance-bot.
